// FAQ

Questions, answered

+Who is eligible for the OSHI allocation?

Wallets included in the official snapshot are eligible to claim.

+Which wallet do I need?

Any Solana wallet address works with the claim portal.

+Is there a deadline?

Claims are open now. Claim early to make sure you don't miss out.

+Does claiming cost anything?

Only the standard, tiny Solana network fee.
